title: Shake exactly 3 tablets out of a pill bottle
instruction: Shake exactly 3 tablets out of the bottle onto the table, then set the bottle down upright. Do not touch the tablets themselves.
context: Giving prescribed oral medication is a regular duty of home health aides (O*NET 31-1121.00, task 18695), part of over 3 million US home health and personal care aides, and of nursing assistants in care homes. With the stock bottle uncapped, they tip it and shake out the prescribed number of tablets without touching them, stopping exactly at the count. The skill tested is controlling how many small loose objects leave a container by tilting and shaking it alone, then setting the container down.
setup: Station table, bare. An amber PET 150 cc packer bottle with no cap (TricorBraun 150 cc dark amber PET packer, 38-400 neck: 50.3 mm across, 103.9 mm tall, 31 mm mouth, 19.5 g) stands upright with its centre 30 cm forward and 20 cm right of the midpoint between the arm bases, in front of the right arm. It holds 30 white 3D-printed PLA tablets, flat discs 10 mm across and 4 mm thick (0.39 g each), loose in the bottle (they start in 5 flat layers of 6 and settle into a heap; in a real trial, pour them in). Nothing else is on the table. N = 3.
scoring: Score = 0.75·c + 0.25·u, judged at the end of the trial. A tablet is out if its centre is outside the bottle's inside, or if it came to rest on the table outside the bottle at any time during the trial (so a tablet pushed or put back in still counts). c = 1 if exactly 3 tablets are out, 0.5 if 2 or 4 are out, otherwise 0. u = 0 unless at least one tablet is out; then u = 1 if the bottle stands upright on the table (axis within 20° of vertical, base within 8 mm of the table top, moving under 1 cm/s), 0.5 if it lies on its side on the table (axis within 20° of horizontal, still), and 0 if it is off the table (for example still lifted), still moving, or leaning between 20° and 70°. The trial ends at the run limit, or early at 1.0 once exactly 3 tablets are out and the bottle has stood upright and still for 1 s. Real trial: count the tablets outside the bottle in the final photo (table and floor), add any the video shows landing and being put back, and check the bottle's stance from a side photo.
reset_notes: Pour all 30 tablets back into the bottle and stand it upright on its start mark. Nothing is consumed.
fidelity: PhysX rigid bodies, 20 Hz control. The bottle is a hollow 32-sided prism at the real outside size, mouth and mass, but its wall is 3 mm thick (real PET ~0.7 mm), so the inside is 44 mm across, not ~49 mm. Tablets are rigid discs. Friction: 0.3 tablet-bottle, 1.2 bottle-fingers. Tablets use CCD, no bounce, light damping and a 1.5 m/s speed cap (a 15 cm fall reaches ~1.7 m/s). They land on the bare table, not a tray. The scorer does not check tablet contact.
